steps.content: 08:57 Square Boulevard

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: (Static noise) Chief... Chief... you there? (Static noise)

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Hello, Adjutant, the Legion speaking. Tell everyone, including the Public Security Bureau, that your Chief has been kidnapped again.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: If you don't want him to come to any harm, stop calling and butt out.
steps.female_content: If you don't want her to come to any harm, stop calling and butt out.

steps.content: As soon as he finishes, he crumbles the walkie-talkie with his hand and turns that familiar poker face of his to you.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Are you happy with this?

options: Very much. Now I can act freely

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Provided that your adjutant is buying this little trick.

options: It's not the first time I have been kidnapped by you anyway

steps.content: She's a loyal adjutant; even if she sees through the trick, she'll still do as you've asked and fend off questions from the higher-ups.
If she chooses to do otherwise... then you'll have no misgivings whatsoever...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Adjutant Nightingale is going to worry sick.
The situation you're facing is convoluted. You have to eliminate risks first. From this moment on, and until all is unveiled, you can trust nobody but yourself.

steps.speaker: Broadcast
steps.content: Conference hall is under attack! A repeat. Conference hall is under attack! Security unit, S-Class alert initiated, defend against the residual forces of the Legion. Defend the square at all costs!

steps.speaker: Broadcast
steps.content: Repeat. Defend the square at all costs!

The conference hall has plunged into chaos. Accompanied by the penetrating shrike of sirens, the sheriffs quickly assemble and set up multiple layers of defense against the upcoming attacks from the Legion outside.
The residual forces of the Legion are now staying in several secluded hideouts near the square, watching the goings-on. You're among them.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: They've let several teams of gangsters get into their defense network through Sewers 6 and 18. Looks like the Bureau is gonna intercept us with the security unit and let the gangsters with Mania weapons attack Zoya...

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: Screw it. Boss has started the fire anyway, and it's time for us to make it burn brighter! Charge at those mother*****!
Both sides have never wanted to sit down for a negotiation. You want to kill each other off, and I've been used for trap-setting by both sides.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: You caught on quick, and now you're using me instead.

options: Looks like you and Zoya didn't agree on the details though.

steps.content: His face falls.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I wish the commander had been more cold-hearted in using you, to either lure you to our side, or lock you up for the Legion.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: That way, she wouldn't have risked going deep into the lion's den by herself, betting on something that doesn't even exist. She did that all because of you.
Although you've already allied yourself with this man, he still looks down his nose and makes barbed remarks at you.

options: Horo wouldn't resent you so much if you were a bit nicer.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yahoo, that stings, doesn't it, advisor and loving brother?... Hey, don't look at me like that. Be nicer to girls.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: We're wasting time here. Time for action. Now, the main forces of the Legion are gonna feign an attack from the front to stall the Public Security Bureau, and I'm gonna go down to the sewer system through a secret passage in Street 13. Then I'll go deep into the square to find the commander.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: Well... I was starting to think things went smoothly in this secret passage. Looks like I was getting ahead of myself.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's the FAC!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Unlike the sheriffs, the FAC focuses on defense; they don't have much of an appetite for offense.
The FAC stayed put when the sheriffs assembled to attack the conference hall... This feels odd to you.
Are they not under the command of the DisCity Public Security Bureau? And are they guarding against something else?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Even if they have no desire to attack, they'll definitely not let us pass. There's only one way. Get ready to attack!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hold on! ${PlayerName} is in an awkward position here. ${PlayerName} can't just jump ship. We need a strategy! So...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We should do this strategy thing. Strategy... That's it, strategy. Come on! Come on!
Looking at her excited face with a mischievous grin, you sigh.
All right, you're gonna do what you're best at...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Everybody! The Legion's attacking, prepared to confront them... Wait a second. They've taken someone hostage. Is that... the new MBCC Chief?!

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Yeah, the Sinners turned their Chief over to me, as a gift for allowing them to join the Legion.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: This man means a lot to you, right? I've fixed a bomb in his head. If you don't want to see him dead, then get out of the way.
steps.female_content: This woman means a lot to you, right? I've fixed a bomb in her head. If you don't want to see her dead, then get out of the way.

steps.content: Earl grabs the nape of your neck. Over the past few days, you've grown accustomed to being kidnapped. The FAC team is swayed; you decide to play along...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Please... I don't want to die. Help me

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Darn it! We have no choice. We have to save that MBCC Chief!
